Build a cannon strong enough to reach the edge of the world.
advancements.farlands_pearl_cannon.far_t: Finish building a Farlands Pearl Cannon.
advancements.farlands_pearl_cannon.how_d: Blast yourself to the Far Lands with the cannon.
gui.farlands_pearl_cannon.dial.title: Where do you want to fly?
gui.farlands_pearl_cannon.hud.title: Cannon Builder
gui.farlands_pearl_cannon.hud.pin_hint: Look at the ground where the back of your cannon should go, then right-click. The barrel points the way you're facing.
gui.farlands_pearl_cannon.hud.pin_here: Right-click to place the blueprint here! The barrel points the way you're facing.
gui.farlands_pearl_cannon.hud.plan_core: Floor done! Now place the Cannon Core on the gold beam.
gui.farlands_pearl_cannon.hud.hint.towar: Just place it on the white box! It turns to face the barrel by itself.
gui.farlands_pearl_cannon.hud.hint.core_: Place it while looking toward the end of the barrel.
gui.farlands_pearl_cannon.hud.hint.away_: Place it while looking back toward the core.
message.farlands_pearl_cannon.dial.no_ca: This dial needs to be on a cannon to work.
message.farlands_pearl_cannon.core.incom: Not done yet! Step %s of %s (%s): %s blocks to go. Hold the projector to see where they go.
Next up: right-click the core with an Ender Pearl.
Next up: right-click the core with %s more Blaze Powder or Eyes of Ender.
The cannon is cooling off. Try again in %ss.
All set! The lever is already on, so flip it off and back on (or right-click the core).
All set! Stand close and flip the lever on top of the core. Hold on tight!
message.farlands_pearl_cannon.launch.no_: No pearl yet! Right-click the core with an Ender Pearl, then try again.
Needs more fuel (%s/%s). Right-click the core with Blaze Powder or Eyes of Ender, then try again.
message.farlands_pearl_cannon.launch.fir: The cannon is charging. Hold on tight!
message.farlands_pearl_cannon.launch.bor: The world border is in the way, so you'll land just inside it.
message.farlands_pearl_cannon.launch.abo: Launch cancelled. Don't worry, your pearl and fuel are back in the cannon.
message.farlands_pearl_cannon.launch.wal: You wandered too far, so the launch was cancelled. Your pearl and fuel are back in the cannon. Stay close next time!
message.farlands_pearl_cannon.launch.str: Welcome to the Far Lands! When you want to go home, use your Anchor Pearl or type /farlandscannon return.
message.farlands_pearl_cannon.build.comp: ✦ You built the cannon! Now load it: 1 Ender Pearl and %s Blaze Powder (or Eyes of Ender).
Blueprint placed! Fill the glowing outline with iron blocks, then put the Cannon Core on the gold beam.
Blueprint moved! Fill the glowing outline with iron blocks, then put the Cannon Core on the gold beam.
You already placed a blueprint nearby. Shift + right-click to move it here.
The guide is following your cannon nearby. Shift + right-click to start a new blueprint.
That's too far away. Look at a spot on the ground a bit closer.
Everything you need for the cannon:
Guide on! Keep holding the projector to see the next step.
You got the Cannon Field Manual! Right-click it to read.
You got the Cannon Field Manual!
You already have the Cannon Field Manual.
message.farlands_pearl_cannon.manual.gra: You're building a cannon! Here's the Cannon Field Manual to help. Right-click it to read.
message.farlands_pearl_cannon.return.too: This only works out in the Far Lands. You're too close to home!
tooltip.farlands_pearl_cannon.anchor_pea: Right-click to warp back to your bed.
No bed? It takes you to world spawn.
Lost it? Type /farlandscannon return while in the Far Lands.
tooltip.farlands_pearl_cannon.blueprint_: Shows you how to build the cannon, step by step.
Right-click the ground to place a blueprint.
Shift + right-click to move it somewhere else.
White box = place here. Green = done. Red = wrong block.
Lost your manual? Shift + right-click at the sky.
Tip: hold it in your offhand so you can build.
tooltip.farlands_pearl_cannon.farlands_c: Hold the Blueprint Projector to see where everything goes.
Right-click it with an empty hand to see what it needs.
tooltip.farlands_pearl_cannon.pearl_cham: A cannon part. The projector shows where it goes.
tooltip.farlands_pearl_cannon.direction_: A cannon part. The projector shows where it goes.
Right-click it on your cannon to pick where you'll fly.
